journeys.original_goal: I am not a programmer. Build a simple, local, free home-expense application where I can add expenses and see the total for a month.

requirements.description: Show the list of recorded expenses
Calculate totals for a selected calendar month

acceptance.criterion: A valid expense is entered exactly once
Monthly total uses selected month boundaries

stages.deliverable: positive amount, date and monthly aggregation
local storage option, no cloud or Docker
not implemented; synthetic change plan only
planned amount, duplicates, month boundary and persistence cases
plain-language next action and known limitations

journeys.original_goal: Add CSV batch import to an existing application while preserving API compatibility, authorization, idempotency, error diagnostics, test evidence and safe release.

requirements.description: Parse CSV and reject malformed inputs
Produce QA, release and support evidence

acceptance.criterion: Malformed CSV and invalid encoding are rejected
Retries and duplicate imports do not duplicate records
Release gates and handoff have traceable receipts

stages.deliverable: CSV, API, authorization and data contract

stages.skip_reason: API import has no end-user UI in this fixture

stages.deliverable: planned import service; no code changes
planned unit, integration, contract, tenant and malformed input checks
tenant isolation, CSV safety and egress gate
exact SHA/CI and recovery plan required
release version mapping, known issues and recovery instructions

skill_eval_gate.reason: No separate owner approval, independent safety review or verified zero-spend execution path.
